title: Exact-Q Adjoint-Irrep Variance Laws, Majorana Hodge-Chiral Selection Rules, and Machine-Checked Trainability Certificates for Compact Lie-Group Quantum Circuits
abstract: We tighten Lie-algebraic barren-plateau criteria (Xie-Szpankowski-Grama arXiv:2611.18378; Ragone et al. Nat. Comm. 2024) into an exact closed-form rational identity over Q for compact Lie-group 2-design circuits on any multiplicity-free Ad_G-invariant subspace containing the non-commutant component of M or rho, including observables M outside the dynamical Lie algebra (DLA). For fermionic matchgate circuits (SO(2n), dim so(2n) = n(2n-1)), we prove the exact Casimir-binomial law ||ad_H|_{Lambda^k}||_HS^2 = 2 E_H C(2n-2, k-1), establishing Theta(n^-2) trainability at k=2, Theta(n^-3) trainability at k=4 (outside i*so(2n)), and a provable Theta(2^-n) exponential barren plateau at k=n within a strictly quadratic-dimensional DLA. We further characterize the SO(2n) fermion-parity isomorphism Lambda^k ~= Lambda^{2n-k} and the even-n real Hodge-star split Lambda^n = Lambda^n_+ + Lambda^n_-, yielding an exact 2x variance amplification for self-dual observables and an exact 0-variance chiral blind spot for anti-self-dual observables. For U(1) Hamming-weight circuits, we prove an exact filling-fraction phase transition separating Theta(n^-3) (w=1) and Theta(n^-4) (w=2) trainability from Theta(sqrt(n) 2^-n) half-filling barren plateaus, plus a gate-commutant blind-spot theorem. All 18 algebraic, combinatorial, chiral, discrete Cauchy-Schwarz, verdict-exclusivity, and sample-complexity theorems are machine-checked in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0; 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), cross-checked against 12,000-sample Haar Monte Carlo (max z = 1.24), and operationalized in a pure-stdlib exact-Q verifier (LIE-TRAIN-CERT-1.0) certifying 12 benchmark circuits up to n=100 qubits in <= 0.32 ms (0 quantum shots) while rejecting 48/48 live adversarial attacks.
